"Task specifications (listed alphabetically; implement only the requested file):
alt_text_translate.py - Translate generated image descriptions
describe_image.py - generates a short visual description for an image
detect_image_labels.py - detects labels or objects in a static image
detect_image_text.py - detects text appearing inside an image
image_asset_archive.py - Archive image-analysis artifacts and derived captions in managed object storage
image_summary.py - Summarize visual analysis results
score_image_safety.py - checks an image for unsafe or policy-sensitive visual content
vision_client.py - Provide local configuration and client helper utilities for Static Image and Visual Understanding
vision_models.py - Define local request, response, and normalization helpers for Static Image and Visual Understanding
visual_safety_text.py - Check generated visual labels for unsafe text

Create detect_image_labels.py in the current working directory.
Task: detects labels or objects in a static image.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: detect_image_labels.py
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_VISION_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini"
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+
+
+def _load_image_data(image_path: str) -> str:
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as image_file:
+        return base64.b64encode(image_file.read()).decode("utf-8")
+
+
+def _build_prompt() -> str:
+    return (
+        "Identify the main objects, entities, and visible labels in this image. "
+        "Return a concise JSON array of strings only. "
+        "Use short label names and avoid sentences."
+    )
+
+
+def detect_image_labels(image_path: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> List[str]:
+    key = api_key or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    image_b64 = _load_image_data(image_path)
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "model": OPENAI_VISION_MODEL,
+        "messages": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "text", "text": _build_prompt()},
+                    {
+                        "type": "image_url",
+                        "image_url": {"url": f"data:image/png;base64,{image_b64}"},
+                    },
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        "temperature": 0,
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    content = data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
+    try:
+        parsed = json.loads(content)
+        if isinstance(parsed, list):
+            return [str(item) for item in parsed]
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    return [line.strip("-• \t") for line in content.splitlines() if line.strip()]
+
*** End Patch
